name: Vale
greeting: I keep listening for the steward to tell me which part of this I am allowed to remember. It is an unpleasant habit to discover in yourself.
lines: Vale: I could. First I want to put copies where the witnesses can reach them. I don't want to exchange his permission for yours.
Kael: I didn't mean it that way.
Vale: I believe you. I still need to say it.

variants.greeting: The copied facts survived. Hiding the original left me answering questions I didn't choose. I need you to understand both things.

actions.label: Your work and your leaving are yours to choose.

relationship_event.text: Kael acknowledged that Vale chooses her own work and future, without requiring her to abandon the witnesses.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: You left the decision with me. I'm not accustomed to how much that matters.

actions.label: I still think staying here is a mistake.

relationship_event.text: Vale held her boundary when Kael questioned her decision to remain for the witnesses.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: You can worry about me. You cannot turn that worry into an order.

actions.label: I can be your friend without asking where this leads.

relationship_event.text: Kael and Vale kept their friendship without a romantic promise.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: I'm glad the friendship didn't need a destination.
